item.title: Custom Cosmetic Paper Box Packaging
item.description:
Guangdong Bincai Color Printing has been manufacturing premium cosmetic packaging since 2003. Our 10,000m² factory with KBA and Heidelberg presses produces 1.7 million boxes daily.

Cosmetic Packaging Solutions

Rigid Gift Boxes

Luxury two-piece rigid boxes with magnetic closure, velvet inserts, and gold foil stamping. Perfect for high-end skincare, perfume, and makeup gift sets.

Folding Cartons

Custom CMYK printed cartons with window cutouts, spot UV, and soft-touch lamination. Ideal for retail cosmetic products.

item.title: Custom Electronics Paper Box Packaging
item.description:
Bincai manufactures premium packaging for electronics and tech products. Our rigid boxes with custom foam inserts provide both protection and luxury unboxing experience.

Electronics Packaging Solutions

Rigid Gift Boxes

Premium two-piece boxes with custom foam/EVA inserts for headphones, speakers, smart devices.

Folding Cartons

Cost-effective printed cartons for accessories, cables, chargers, and small electronics.

Corrugated Mailers

Sturdy shipping boxes with custom print for e-commerce electronics delivery.

item.title: Custom Food Paper Box Packaging
item.description:
Guangdong Bincai Color Printing offers food-grade paper packaging manufactured under ISO 9001 and FSC certified conditions. All food packaging uses food-safe inks and materials.

Food Packaging Solutions

Tea & Coffee Boxes

Custom rigid and folding boxes for tea bags, loose leaf tea, coffee beans, and ground coffee. Airtight options with valve.

Snack & Confectionery

Folding cartons with window cutouts for cookies, chocolates, candies, and snacks. Grease-resistant coating available.

item.title: Custom Gift Paper Box Packaging
item.description:
Guangdong Bincai Color Printing specializes in premium gift packaging that creates memorable unboxing experiences. Since 2003, we’ve manufactured millions of custom gift boxes for global brands.

Gift Packaging Solutions

Corporate Gift Boxes

Premium rigid boxes with embossed logos, magnetic closure, and custom inserts for corporate gifting, employee appreciation, and client gifts.

Holiday & Seasonal

Custom printed boxes for Christmas, Lunar New Year, Valentine’s Day, and special occasions. Foil stamping, ribbon pulls, themed designs.

item.title: Custom Luxury Paper Box Packaging
item.description:
Bincai manufactures luxury packaging that reflects your brand’s premium positioning. Each box is crafted with precision on our KBA and Heidelberg presses.

Luxury Packaging Solutions

Premium Rigid Boxes

2-3mm greyboard construction wrapped in premium art paper. Magnetic closure, velvet flocking, gold foil stamping for ultimate luxury feel.

Limited Edition Packaging

Custom shapes, special finishes, numbered editions for exclusive product launches and luxury collections.

Brand Experience

Every box we produce is designed to create a lasting impression — from the weight of the box to the reveal experience.
